items.en: Are you mad? The conversation may have dried up but you had no reason to ask her if she wanted a pee.

items.en: Perhaps you are some sort of pervert. Perhaps you imagine her fidgeting about, shifting up and down on the chair, crossing her legs, but too shy to tell you she wants to go to the loo. Maybe you even want her to get more and more desperate. If so, shame on you!
